description: Named as the man in the skin. He was not in the room.
name: Edward Alleyn

description: Raye reported the end, the skin, the mast, and the monsters, and swore no height.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Asked the timber, forbade a sum, and named ten shillings and the second of June.
name: James Burbage

description: Named the gowns, the thin yard, and the giant over the water.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Asked how tall, scowled into the cup, and refused a club.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Said he had not gone, kept the king at home, and left.
name: William Shakespeare
